appointments_confirmed_check.name: appointments_confirmed_check
appointments_confirmed_check.value: "appointments"."status" not in ('booked', 'completed', 'no_show') or "appointments"."confirmed_at" is not null

barber_sales_appointment_key.name: barber_sales_appointment_key
barber_sales_appointment_key.where: appointment_id is not null and status <> 'void'

barber_terms_rent_check.name: barber_terms_rent_check
barber_terms_rent_check.value: "barber_terms"."rent_amount" = 0 or ("barber_terms"."rent_amount" > 0 and "barber_terms"."rent_period" is not null and "barber_terms"."rent_starts_on" is not null)
